# Q4 Engineering Plan

**Status:** Draft, reviewed with TLs at Eng Staff 2026-10-05. Locks after the Oct 16 go/no-go.
**Quarter:** October-December 2026

## Frame

Q3 was supposed to be the investing quarter. It was the ACH quarter, the KYC quarter and the beta quarter, and investing is still not GA. Q4 is about finishing: investing GA, closing the money-movement safety gaps that Sep 26 exposed, and getting through Series B diligence without a surprise.

Last quarter's plan is Q3 Engineering Plan. Most of what slipped is listed below.

## Top priorities (in order)

### 1. Investing GA

- GA target Oct 20. At risk.
- Blockers from Go-No-Go 1 - Investing GA: reconciliation fix (Devon Park, in review, due Oct 14), disclosures (Hana Ito, signed Oct 7), Android parity on 2 screens (due Oct 15).
- Go/no-go #2 on Oct 16 (Renee Alvarez runs it).
- After GA: the $2,500 daily funding cap stays until 90 days post-launch per Pillar's sign-off.

Owner: Renee (product), Devon (reconciliation), Nadia Okafor (mobile).

### 2. Money-movement safety

- Idempotency keys on every money-moving job (ADR-031 - Idempotency Keys for All Money-Moving Jobs). Marcus Bell, due Oct 23.
- Move the round-up sweep onto the outbox pipeline (ADR-032 - Move Round-up Sweep onto the Outbox Pipeline). Design in October, build in November, cut-over in December with a shadow period.
- Delete the old Sidekiq ACH code (Sidekiq ACH Decommission Plan). Devon, due Oct 16.
- NACHA-cutoff alert tuning (Runbook - NACHA Cutoff Alert). Marcus, due Oct 13.
- Written remediation plan for Pillar (Pillar Bank Remediation Plan - Sep 26 Incident). Maya, due Oct 15.

### 3. Series B diligence and close

- Data room engineering section due Oct 12. Technical diligence call with Elena Sorensen Oct 14. Board meeting Oct 21. Close Nov 14.

### 4. SOC 2 Type II

- Close the three readiness gaps: Q3 access review (Sam Whitfield, due Oct 10), vendor risk assessments for the last 2 of 4 vendors (due Oct 24), MDM to 100% (due Oct 17).
- Q4 access review run on time in December.

### 5. Hiring

- VP Engineering decision by Oct 20.
- First wave of the post-close plan (Hiring Plan - Post Series B): 2 payments, 1 senior iOS, 1 SRE in Q4.

## What we are NOT doing in Q4

- Card issuing build. Soft launch moved to Q1 2027 (Card Issuing - Timeline Change). Q4 is design and vendor setup only.
- Postgres sharding work.
- Growth experiments on money-moving flows until GA plus two weeks (Growth Experiments - Freeze During Beta).
- New Go services outside money movement.

## Capacity

31 engineers. Payments & platform (Marcus): roughly all of it goes to items 2 and 1. Mobile (Nadia): Android parity, then investing polish and the iOS refactor. Data (Devon): reconciliation, then Sidekiq deletion, then the ML feature work that slipped from Q3. Growth (Kavi Raman): post-GA experiment backlog and onboarding.

Risk: Marcus is the owner on three of the five money-movement items. If he goes down, Q4 goes down. Sarah Kim takes the Pillar weekly ops sync and the NACHA alert follow-ups.

Risk: Diligence and the board meeting eat a week of my time and a few days of Marcus's and Devon's.

Decision: No new engineering commitments land in Q4 until investing passes go/no-go #2.

Open question: Does the round-up sweep cut-over happen before or after the holiday freeze (Dec 18)? Leaning before, with a shadow period starting Nov 30.

## Commitments

- [ ] Devon: land position reconciliation fix by 2026-10-14
- [ ] Nadia: ship Android parity for the two investing screens by 2026-10-15
- [ ] Renee: run go/no-go #2 by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Devon: delete Sidekiq ACH code by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Marcus: tune NACHA-cutoff alert by 2026-10-13
- [ ] Marcus: idempotency keys on all money-moving jobs by 2026-10-23
- [ ] Maya: lock Q4 plan after go/no-go #2 by 2026-10-19
